releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.2 PILOT promotion after successful HCSPC2025 DEV recovery testing. Service 0.2.5.1 adds safe Headline Remote self-healing, authoritative Mesh Agent registry NodeId matching, trusted MeshCentral presence signals, automatic recovery of stopped MeshAgent, and controlled restart only after three confirmed offline observations. Recovery is limited to three attempts in 30 minutes with persisted lockout and maintenance pause protection. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
